scope: Synchronous P180/D155 cells on disjoint RAN home GPUs. Qualification is mode-specific over home cell count, recovery bound, executor ordering, lifecycle, shared-AI broker, declared control-plane fault class, and the full synchronous prepare/commit/complete budget and post-apply fault-point coverage; later falsification demotes earlier finite-sample points. C134 adds an independent allocation and node requalification for the full-budget three-control-point QSU mode within the same A100 hardware family. Version 9 derives conditional recovery release per home from that home's admitted NeuralRx jobs and is audited against an independent exact endpoint-admission oracle. Version 10 further distinguishes W+Delta capacity geometry from the sufficient exchange window at the current observe-all decision boundary; the latter charges the latest admitted NeuralRx path bound and sequential recovery for rejected NeuralRx jobs before testing an AI transaction. Version 11 caps synchronous NeuralRx admission by the physical CUDA-IPC ring depth and makes rejected-recovery-before-exchange an executor-mode property. Version 12 separately charges the physical AI completion guard in addition to the radio commit guard and any synchronous broker transaction budget. Version 13 rejects the former equality between the 5 ms socket timeout and an RPC wall-time bound after C138, separates a prospective 7 ms admission charge, and replaces the invalidated AI40 exchange-only class with the corrected AI35+control21+completion2 class validated by C140. Version 14 moves prepare, abort, and complete to a separate control connection, revalidates prepared work against the current local certificate, and keeps only the launch-authorizing commit on the RAN critical path. C142-C144 qualify AI45+commit7+completion2=54 ms and the three post-apply fault points on two A100 nodes. Version 15 preserves V14 timing but adds an explicit one-unlaunched-token-per-home ownership contract. A deterministic two-request audit found that V14 could issue prepare behind a retained staged token; V15 suppresses that transition and exposes physical branch counters. Version 16 requires physical post-apply reply-loss coverage for prepare, abort, commit, and complete. V15 had two-node physical coverage for prepare/commit/complete but only finite-model and normal-path evidence for abort.
